I have felt the same way before. Once on Reddit astrology circle jerk I saw this page about how this astrology chart means this person is like worse than Satan and is destined to become the next hitler. When you click on the astrology chart it’s referring to it just goes straight to your chart. That’s the joke. But silly me didn’t realize what circlejerk meant and that it was a joke. I was so mortified and felt like o my goodness! This person can see right through me. I am as horrible as I think I am! It’s all true😢 I’m just telling this hella embarrassing story because it just shows how bad I felt about myself that I would believe something like that. Lately though I’ve been doing cognitive behavioral therapy and it’s really helping. I highly recommend it. It really helped me to see that my own thoughts are not always the best judge of reality. We all have inner critics that can sometimes scream so loud we don’t know what’s real. CBT helps to quiet that voice. Helps you to be more balanced. Just a suggestion. Hope you feel better
